name: Nightmare
description: A hand-sized, impossibly fast will-o'-the-wisp of a horse that flies true rather than gliding, and is gone the instant anything moves toward it. Cracked blood-red veins run under its coat, its hooves and its eyes burn gold, and its mane is spun gold too. It flees everything alive on sight; a cake will draw one close, and enough cake fed to a grown one buys a permanent truce. Milk it and the bottle comes back cursed - weak, and touched with something darker than any ordinary potion.
notes: Shares its liver-bay base (E/E, A/A, Sh/ShD) with the Netherhorse, since nothing else was asked for it - the two breeds are a matched family, not two unrelated designs. Emberveins is Emb/Emb, the same pair as the Netherhorse's, and it is left unbanded on purpose: the gene's hue knob is only read by the rust expression (Emr/Emr), while the glowing expression Emb/Emb produces paints fixed hex (#ff5a1f, #ff8a3d, #ffd9c2) and never looks at it. A hue band here was tried and removed - it stored and inherited a number nothing on this horse could draw, so the two breeds' veins read the same and the difference has to come from the loci that do vary: gold hooves, mane and eyes against the Netherhorse's red.

Skittish is Faa/Faa - flees everything, always (SkittishGene.Target.EVERYTHING) - and aggression is explicitly pinned to n/n so a wild default chance of the opposite temperament can never land on this breed; a nightmare only ever runs, never fights.

Passification is Prm/Prm: permanently passified, at any age (Window.ANY, unlike the Netherhorse's adults-only route) - a foal or a grown nightmare can both be won over the same way. The offering is banded to index 13 of PassificationGene.OFFERINGS, minecraft:cake, which this breed adds; duration and cooldown are left unbanded since Prm is a permanent route and never reads either. THIS ALSO NEEDED A CODE FIX: PassificationGene's veto (Passification.suppresses) was asked before a horse attacked a player but never before one fled a player, so a calmed nightmare would still have bolted from you. GeneAbilityHandler's flee() now asks it too, and Passification.forget() drops the flee leg already issued rather than leaving the horse to run out the remaining twelve blocks - both halves are what let 'tempted over, then permanently calmed, with cake' actually hold once bought. Cake also joins the wild offering roll by being in the list at all; see the Netherhorse's note on nether wart.

True flight is Tf/Tf (FlyingGene) rather than the commoner gliding allele - hovers and flies wherever it is pointed, indefinitely, no wings required. It grants no fall protection of its own (that is bird-boned's locus, not named here).

Milk: PotionMilkGene's Wkn/Drk is a compound heterozygote (two different brew alleles), so the bottle carries BOTH effects at the weak grade in one drink - Weakness, as asked, and Darkness as the thematic second half. Darkness was picked over Nausea/Blindness because the effect is named for exactly what a 'Nightmare' should hand you: a vision that dims and crawls rather than one that merely spins. Both alleles (Wkn, Drk) are new - PotionMilkGene had no negative effects in its brew list at all before this breed, only buffs.
Particle is Rflm/Rflm - ParticleGene's 'Flame' variant, minecraft:flame, the same particle a torch burns - 'torch flame particles' as asked, not the Netherhorse's Lava embers.

Molten hooves is MltC/MltC, the same locus and pair as the Netherhorse, banded gold here instead of red - so the two breeds' glowing hoofprints read as a matched pair from a distance despite being unrelated combinations genetically.

Eyes and mane: Gld/Gld at both iris loci is EyeColourGene's fixed gold hue; there is no fixed gold sclera hue, so the whites use Cha/Cha (EyeHue.CHAOS) banded toward gold on eye_chaos_r/g/b, with Glo/Glo at every glow locus so the whole eye glows, matching the Netherhorse's red-glow treatment in gold. Only mane_color is named and banded gold - the tail was left wild since nothing was said about it, so a nightmare's tail is whatever its liver-bay base gives it rather than a second golden hair locus.

Stats: speed 5 is the plain baseline (no locus is forced when a resolved band sits inside BreedStatCurve.NEUTRAL_LO..NEUTRAL_HI, so 'average speed' really does mean nothing is pushing it). Jump 10 is the ceiling, about x3.43 of baseline. Pull 1 is the floor pull score, padded out with no curve (BreedStatCurve treats pull as the resolved number itself). Size [0.32, 0.42] is below even a Falabella's [0.38, 0.51] and well outside the x0.7..x1.3 heterozygous band, so every founder is homozygous for size and the breed throws its own tiny size true. No health or milk-volume locus is named, so both roll at the ordinary wild rate - nothing was asked about either.

Every biome named is in the Nether, for the same reason as the Netherhorse's: a horse still needs grass and light to spawn, so wild herds of this breed will rarely or never actually appear, and spawn_egg is the reliable way to obtain one.

Suggested but not included here: bird-boned (fall immunity to go with true flight - a strong combination, but not asked for and arguably too strong stacked on a horse this hard to even approach), and Third Eye or a Shadowcreature-style extra glow for more hallucination flavour, held back so the breed stays readable as 'small, gold, and gone' rather than growing a second gimmick nobody requested.
